research_question: After the frozen U.S., HKMA and SGX A50 information channels, does China domestic industrial/construction futures price discovery generated strictly in the post-A-share-close night session add explanatory information about the next CSI1000 09:31 opening gap?
financial_rationale: CU and RB represent two complementary China-sensitive real-economy channels: broad industrial/global-China cyclicality and domestic construction/infrastructure. The experiment tests them as one predefined domestic-night information block rather than mining which commodity happens to forecast the consumed holdout best.

SHFE_RB.quarantine_semantics: if previous China trading date falls inside this inclusive interval, RB night return is unavailable; no clock inference is made from target results

causal_contract_selection.selection_time: previous China trading day 15:00:00 Beijing time
causal_contract_selection.eligible_contract: delivery month-year not earlier than previous China calendar month and at least one observed bar in 09:00:00-14:55:00 on the previous China trading date
causal_contract_selection.ranking: largest sum of 5-minute volume over previous China trading date 09:00:00-14:55:00

product_feature_semantics.start: selected exact contract 14:55:00 bar close on previous China trading date; the bar ending at the 15:00 mainland close must exist
product_feature_semantics.night_activity_requirement: at least one positive-volume 5-minute bar must exist in the selected contract's frozen night-session window beginning on the previous China trading date; otherwise the product return is unavailable
product_feature_semantics.end: close of the last positive-volume selected-contract bar inside that frozen night-session window; for CU the window may extend through 01:00 on the target calendar date
product_feature_semantics.holiday_eve: unavailable when no actual positive-volume night observation exists; no synthetic session may be created

composite_feature.name: domestic_night_cyclical_return
composite_feature.availability: available only when both CU and RB product returns are available under the frozen rules
composite_feature.missing_component: exclude the row from both comparator and candidate common-sample adjudication; do not renormalize the surviving component

bulk_source_contract.delivery_files_extending_beyond_2020: permitted only if the extractor scans datetime first and stops before parsing/using OHLCV values after 2020-12-31

data_quality_gates_before_model.if_any_hard_gate_fails: do not execute or adjudicate v7; repair data/schema/clock only without changing feature, product, weight or model definitions

common_sample.rule: V6 comparator and V7 candidate use identical training and holdout rows where the entire frozen V6 feature set is valid and domestic_night_cyclical_return is available
common_sample.no_night_rows: excluded from both candidates in this mechanism experiment
common_sample.future_fallback_experiment: if v7 passes, full-coverage fallback to V6 on objectively unavailable domestic-night rows requires a separate preregistration and may not be inferred from this experiment

attempts.features: exact frozen v6 feature set, refit only on the v7 common training sample

primary_adjudication.same_sample_R2: V7A holdout R2 > V6A common-sample comparator R2
primary_adjudication.same_sample_SSE: V7A holdout SSE < comparator holdout SSE
primary_adjudication.IC: V7A holdout IC > comparator holdout IC
primary_adjudication.sign_hit: V7A sign hit may not deteriorate by more than 0.01 absolute
primary_adjudication.annual_stability: V7A SSE must not be worse than comparator in either 2019 or 2020
primary_adjudication.quarterly_stability: across the eight 2019-2020 calendar quarters, total SSE improvement must be positive, median quarterly SSE improvement must be positive, and at least five of eight quarters must have nonnegative SSE improvement
primary_adjudication.coefficient_sign: diagnostic_only_not_a_hard_gate because commodity price changes combine demand information, supply shocks and input-cost effects; financial validity comes from the predeclared information channel and causal clock rather than imposing a post-hoc directional story
primary_adjudication.component_diagnostics: report CU and RB raw feature correlations and standardized composite coefficient after formal adjudication, but do not use component diagnostics to reselect products or weights

R2_aspiration.role: historical research aspiration only; v6 consumed-holdout R2 already exceeded it

forbidden: replace DCE I with another commodity after seeing v7 results
pick only CU or only RB after seeing target metrics
use future full-day volume or open interest for contract choice
fill no-night-session rows with zero or forward values
tune the RB transition quarantine from results
baseline replacement, production, registry mutation or runtime routing from consumed holdout
